title: Acacetin Alleviates Loperamide-Induced Functional Constipation by Inhibiting P53-Mediated Apoptosis in Colonic Epithelial Cells.
authors: Chen, Xia; Yang, Ting; Huang, Yao; Yang, Yaping; Li, Xian; Ma, Yaowei; Long, Haobai; Liao, Ding; Zhang, Peng; Wen, Weibo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金合欢素通过抑制P53介导的结肠上皮细胞凋亡缓解便秘，仅用分子对接初步涉及蛋白-小分子互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Functional constipation (FC) is a prevalent gastrointestinal disorder with limited therapeutic options. Yunweiling (YWL), a traditional Chinese herbal medicine from Radix Inulae extract, has been used for treating constipation, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate the protective effects and mechanisms of acacetin, a bioactive compound of YWL, in alleviating FC. METHODS: Molecular docking analysis was performed to identify the targets of bioactive compounds in YWL formula. A loperamide-induced FC mouse model was established, and the effects of acacetin on gastrointestinal motility, colon histology, and signaling pathways were evaluated. Human colonic mucosal epithelial cells were used to investigate the protective effects of YWL extracts and acacetin against loperamide-induced apoptosis and the involvement of the tumor protein P53 (P53) signaling pathway. RESULTS: Molecular docking analysis revealed acacetin as a bioactive chemical targeting P53 protein. In the FC mouse model, acacetin administration improved gastrointestinal motility, alleviated colon mucosal damage, and suppressed the upregulation of P53 and its downstream apoptotic signaling. In colonic epithelial cells, loperamide induced apoptosis by activating P53 and inhibiting Akt1 signaling, which was attenuated by YWL extract and acacetin treatment. The protective effects of YWL and acacetin were abrogated by the P53 activator Nutlin-3a, suggesting that the inhibition of P53 signaling is crucial for their anti-apoptotic properties. CONCLUSION: Acacetin alleviates loperamide-induced FC by inhibiting P53-mediated apoptosis in colonic epithelial cells, providing new insights into the therapeutic mechanisms of traditional Chinese herbal medicine YWL in treating constipation.
abstract_zh: 背景：功能性便秘（FC）是一种常见的胃肠道疾病，治疗选择有限。云威灵（YWL）是一种源自旋覆花提取物的传统中草药，已用于治疗便秘，但其潜在机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨YWL中生物活性化合物金合欢素（acacetin）缓解FC的保护作用及其机制。方法：进行分子对接分析以识别YWL方剂中生物活性化合物的靶点。建立洛哌丁胺诱导的FC小鼠模型，评估金合欢素对胃肠蠕动、结肠组织学和信号通路的影响。使用人结肠黏膜上皮细胞研究YWL提取物和金合欢素对洛哌丁胺诱导凋亡的保护作用，以及肿瘤蛋白P53（P53）信号通路的参与。结果：分子对接分析揭示金合欢素是一种靶向P53蛋白的生物活性化学物质。在FC小鼠模型中，金合欢素给药改善了胃肠蠕动，减轻了结肠黏膜损伤，并抑制了P53及其下游凋亡信号的上调。在结肠上皮细胞中，洛哌丁胺通过激活P53和抑制Akt1信号诱导凋亡，而YWL提取物和金合欢素处理减弱了这种效应。YWL和金合欢素的保护作用被P53激活剂Nutlin-3a消除，表明抑制P53信号对其抗凋亡特性至关重要。结论：金合欢素通过抑制结肠上皮细胞中P53介导的凋亡来缓解洛哌丁胺诱导的FC，为传统中草药YWL治疗便秘的治疗机制提供了新见解。
